title.zh: UK court ruling boosts government’s chances of keeping $5 billion in seized bitcoin
title.en: UK court ruling boosts government’s chances of keeping $5 billion in seized bitcoin

current_state.zh: A London court held that Chinese law governs fraud victims' claims to 61,000 seized bitcoin worth roughly £3.8 billion, boosting the UK government's odds of keeping most of the funds from Zhimin Qian's Ponzi scheme.
